title: ChatAttachmentRef
description: Generalized attachment reference carried on chat requests and persisted chat messages. Attachments may point to original Files or derived Artifacts.

mimeType.description: Optional MIME type hint for rendering or routing.

inlinePreview.description: If true, UI may show a small inline preview when supported.

evidence.description: Optional evidence pointers that the UI can use to highlight specific slices of an attached Artifact. This is expected mainly on assistant-authored attachments.
